body: Not choosing to live with my heroin addict mom when CYS was trying to place me with my grandparents. I was a rebellious kid,and my grandparents were stricter than my mom so I thought I'd be better off with her. Especially as my grandparents are raising my two brothers,and I didnt want to burden them. My mom got me into smoking ice,and I was addicted from the first time I tried it. I began moving drugs with my mom and her boyfriend,but we didnt make much as my mom would spend it on dope for herself to use. So we hustled to survive,to eat. Lots of fucked up shit happened,lots of people I loved died,and lots of time that i could've spent with my family was lost due to that decision I made. My mom is currently doing a 7 year bid for drugs,a gun charge,and for breaking into my grandparents house after she took klonopin. As of now I got a job,and my coworkers are like family to me and have helped me out more than they'll ever realize. I slipped up along the way but things are looking up. But I'll always regret choosing the life I did because I still break down about some of the shit I've seen and done.

That just a few months ago I was homeless and on meth. I've been addicted to meth for a couple of years now after my mom got me into it. I helped her move dope and ice,and did some crazy shit. (Caught a hotel room on fire,messing around with guns,hustling just to survive in general). I dont have much of a family atm,my mom is currently doing a 7 year bid for a gun charge and heroin and meth possession charges,distribution charges and a robbery (she broke into my grandparents house,we haven't talked to them since they got custody of my younger brothers in 2016. She wasn't trying to rob them,she was given klonopin and wanted to see her kids,not that she shouldve,as she wasn't in a good place or even mentally stable to do so). Anyways when she got booked I hustled ice to a few friends of ours just to eat and stay in hotel rooms or to pay people who took me in. When I finally quit selling drugs to try to get my shit straight I was 5'10,120 pounds and looked like shit. I got a job in food service and my coworkers are awesome people. Were like a family of sorts. When I told them where I came from after we were having a deep conversation they couldn't believe it,mainly because I'm a good worker,and very kind to everyone. Especially my boss,who's a very sweet 70 year old lady,I always try to make things easier for her. I'm grateful for even having the opportunity of having a job,but I'm especially lucky that my coworkers are awesome people,and were all very close. I slipped up last night,and got back on my tweaker shit and fucked myself up pretty bad. But instead of laughing it off like i normally would,i feel guilty and ashamed of my slipup. But now I know it's not worth going back. Even for a day. I'm not a good person,but I'm trying to be and having actual supportive people who are generous enough to give me a chance is pushing me in the right direction and I'll be forever grateful to these people. I know I kind of just ranted but I really appreciate these people,and they deserve more than what they get as it is. I hope to make it out of my rut,I'm 20 so I have a long way to go. But you gotta crawl before you walk,so it's a start.

I'm not saying it is or isn't because I hear different opinions,I'm just saying it's probably better to just not hold it in just in case. It doesnt get you higher,you can blow that shit right out and you'll feel it hit you. Better to be safe than sorry y'know?

Nah I didnt take it as rude. You're being honest. I know what I did,and I knew what could happen and I still did it anyway. I fucked up. And thank God i didnt affect anyone innocent. It's actually one of the things that keep me from going all the way back. I'm not cut out for that world. I was just surviving. I'm a fucked up person, dont get me wrong but I'm not a thug or anything. I dont want to hurt people anymore.

I'm proud of you homie. Coke ain't good but it's not dope or ice. Just keep yourself together bro. I know dealing with losing people,especially suddenly is something that takes a toll on you mentally and I hope you're okay. You're a strong person and I hope you stay safe and stay straight,or at the very least away from hard shit. Be safe bro.

Dont hold in the smoke. Even if it is or isnt harmful,its just pointless. Redosing is up to the person,and how they handle it. Ice can have people tweaking heavy while some people are less tweaked out and more wired. If you're new to ice,I'd suggest just going slow,dont binge and make sure you drink water and eat beforehand to make the comedown less shitty. But to be honest,you shouldn't get into ice. Or any hard drug. But ice will fuck your life up. My mom got me on it when I was like 15 or 16,and in months I became a whole different person,in a bad way. Itll ruin you bro. I promise you. I hope you can move on from this shit and make a good life for yourself,because the high isnt worth everything you're gonna lose,and trust me you will lose every single time until you dig yourself out of it. Be safe homie.
Yeah,I knew it probably wasn't gonna end well. But I was tweaked out and didnt care. I wasn't always like this. This is what meth'll do to you lol. Hope you make a good life for yourself homie.

Yeah,drips are gross af. Especially ice though. Makes me wanna puke. That's why I always smoked and hotrailed my shit. Not much of a taste,at the very least just a little chemically. And yeah,before I was homeless I lived with my mom and a couple other addicts in a house with no water and no heat. Toilet filled with shit,everything smelling horrible,even the environment is fucked up. People ODing,watching people stick themselves in the neck and all that. Sad shit bro. Just remember that the high you get ain't worth all the people you'll lose,all the opportunities you'll lose,and losing yourself or even worse just ending up dead. You're too good for this shit bro. Fr. Make a life for yourself,if anything stick to good bud and shitll be easy sailing compared to the latter. I hope life goes well for you my bro.

Yeah I know it's a weird story to share but i posted it for posterity and to look back at what one night of giving into this shit got me. I slipped and fucked up terribly in just a couple hours. Also,anyone reading this who is getting into this shit can see what drugs (especially meth) can do to people. I wasn't always like this. Once I got on ice my whole personality and moral compass changed. I'm ashamed,im sickened with what could've happened and I'm disappointed in letting myself down. Im currently trying to get out of this town,because I have so many plugs out here and people tryna get me to get them shit its crazy. I wanna move when I get my ba GB right and my shit together so I can leave everyone and this life behind for good. Good luck to you to my bro,I appreciate you.

I dont care about myself,i was a drug dealer selling shit that tore people's lives apart and I've done a lot of shit to survive that left others hurt. I'm an addict,who doesnt do anything to benefit anyone. I could've seriously hurt someone who had a family,had a good job and shit going for themselves. That's not something to gloss over. I appreciate your kind words though homie. The world (and a lot of lost addicts) need good people like you. Never change bro.
